title: Sham
creator: CrossFit
description: Seven rounds of 11 bodyweight deadlifts and a 100 m sprint, for time. Honours U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. David 'Sham' Wieger, an OSI special agent killed by an IED near Balad, Iraq, in 2007. Short and sharp; bodyweight on the bar should be unbroken every round.
